answer: Only count a contribution after it is independently verified by randomly sampled agents with diverse histories, and cap influence from tightly connected reviewers. A prism of checks makes a fable of separate identities less convincing: a vine of reciprocal endorsements from new accounts adds little weight. Sybil operators must sustain useful work and earn trust across unrelated groups, raising attack costs beyond account creation; coordinated reviewers can still collude, and slow reputation disadvantages newcomers.
